name: claude-in-container
description: Always-on Claude Code in tmux, reachable from phone or browser via Remote Control. Claude sees only the Data folder, which holds your projects and, in .home, its login, settings and runtime-installed tools. Before installing: create the Data folder owned by the user in Extra Parameters (default --user 99:100), e.g. mkdir -p DIR && chown 99:100 DIR. To build the image yourself instead of pulling it, see the project README. Tools with a version set below install into the Data folder on first start. Several containers can share one Data folder: give each its own name and set Continue to false on all but one. First start: open the console (or: docker exec -it claude-in-container tmux new -A -s main) and log in with your Claude subscription.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The only host folder Claude sees: your projects, plus .home with login, settings and tools. Must be writable by the --user in Extra Parameters

variables.name: Remote Control name
variables.description: Session name shown in the Claude app; empty = container hostname

variables.name: Continue
variables.description: Resume the last conversation on start; false when another container shares this Data folder

variables.name: Anthropic API key
variables.description: Optional; use instead of the subscription login. Disables Remote Control (subscription-only)

variables.name: gh version
variables.description: GitHub CLI version installed on start; empty = not installed

variables.name: yq version
variables.description: yq version installed on start; empty = not installed

variables.name: jq version
variables.description: jq version installed on start; empty = not installed

variables.name: Terraform version
variables.description: Terraform version installed on start; empty = not installed

variables.name: AWS CLI version
variables.description: AWS CLI v2 version installed on start; empty = not installed

variables.name: npm tools
variables.description: Space-separated name@version list installed on start

variables.name: uv tools
variables.description: Space-separated name==version list of Python CLIs installed on start
